exposure: Type of cardiovascular disease (acquired vs. congenital)
cohort: 70 pregnant women with cardiovascular disease admitted to Cipto Mangunkusumo National Hospital between 2014 and 2018.
finding: Preterm delivery was common (74.3%) in pregnancies affected by maternal cardiovascular disease, and while cesarean section rates and maternal ICU admissions were high (72.9% and 52.9% respectively), maternal mortality remained at 7.1%.
